info.name: Benchling AA Sequences Feature Libraries API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token for pagination

params.name: modifiedAt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Supports the > and < operators. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified in the specified range. e.g. > 2017-04-30. Date ranges can be specified with the following nomenclature > YYYY-MM-DD AND <YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of a Feature Library. Restricts results to those with the specified name.

params.name: nameIncludes
params.description: Name substring of a Feature Library. Restricts results to those with names that include the provided substring.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: names.anyOf
params.description: Comma-separated list of names. Maximum of 100. Restricts results to those that match any of the specified names.

params.name: returning
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Modifies the output shape. To return all keys at a given level, enumerate them or use the wildcard, '*'. For more information, [click here](https://docs.benchling.com/docs/getting-started-1#returning-query-parameter).

params.name: feature_library_id
params.description: ID of feature library to get

params.name: returning
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Modifies the output shape. To return all keys at a given level, enumerate them or use the wildcard, '*'. For more information, [click here](https://docs.benchling.com/docs/getting-started-1#returning-query-parameter).

items.docs: Get a feature library by ID

Update a feature library. Note: Features cannot be updated from this endpoint.
Use the /features* endpoints to add or modify features.

params.name: featureType
params.description: The type of feature, like gene, promoter, etc. Note: This is an arbitrary string, not an enum

params.name: matchType
params.description: The match type of the feature used to determine how auto-annotate matches are made.
